title: Why Trees Matter
text:
Trees are very important for our planet. They give us clean air to breathe. Trees also give shade on hot days. Many birds build their nests in trees.

Rain helps plants and trees grow. Some people plant new trees in parks and forests. Protecting nature is good for everyone. We should not throw trash on the ground.
